computed.deployments: filter(steps.snapshot.json.deployments, (contains(lower(it.name), 'argocd') or contains(lower(it.name), 'flux')) and (it.clusterAdmin == true or it.secretRead == true or it.repoToken != null))
computed.secrets: filter(steps.snapshot.json.secrets, contains(lower(it.name), 'argocd') or contains(lower(it.name), 'flux') or contains(lower(it.name), 'git'))
